messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — Solstice Data (acct SD-778) invoice INV-45321 bounced. ACH return code R04, bank notes 'insufficient funds'. Invoice due 2026-03-14.
InvoiceBot: Reminder: Payment failed for INV-45321 — retry link sent at 2026-03-20 10:02.
Tom Huang: Is this a usage surprise? They had a big spike last month.
Sophia Patel: Reached out to billing contact (sam@solsticedata.com) via email + phone, no pickup. Left voicemail at 10:15.
Aisha Reynolds: Per playbook, offer a 2-installment split without fees if they accept by EOD Fri. Need approval to waive late fee. Also confirm we can suspend API keys if no response.
LegalBot: Per contract T&Cs we wait 30 days past due before referring to collections. Suspending keys allowed after 7 days with prior notice.
Maria Gomez: They mentioned a Net-60 request but I don't see any PO or signed addendum. Contract excerpt: ```Contract: Net-30 standard, clause 4.2```
Tom Huang: Customer says finance contact moved to sam.pay@solsticedata.com — we should verify before sending payment links.
Aisha Reynolds: Approve offering 2-installment plan and waive a single late fee (cap $150). Maria — please prepare updated invoice + payment link. Pause provisioning in 7 days if no plan.
Sophia Patel: I'll send the outreach. Draft I'll use: short options, no novel concessions.
Maria Gomez: Draft message: 'Hi Sam — invoice INV-45321 failed to clear. We can offer 2 equal installments due Apr 5 and May 5, no late fees if accepted by Mar 26. Pay link: https://pay.redwood.com/pay/INV-45321. Reply here or call 415-555-0123 to discuss.'
Tom Huang: :thumbsup: Also flag AM @Evan for renewal conversation.
Evan Brooks: Noted — I'll take renewal touchpoint if they accept.
LegalBot: Please add the installment terms to account notes if they accept. Keep all correspondence.
Maria Gomez: Done — account note set to 'dunning: offered installment'. Payment link sent to sam@solsticedata.com and sam.pay@solsticedata.com (pending verification).
InvoiceBot: Next automated reminder scheduled in 48h.
Sophia Patel: Will follow up again in 48 hrs. Marking as 'escalate if no response by Mar 30'.
Aisha Reynolds: If no response by Mar 30, escalate to collections ops for manual outreach. Thanks everyone.
